A melee hit that downs or kills a hostile has a 30% chance to cast killskip: the wielder skips to the nearest enemy in sight anywhere on the map and strikes twice. They keep jumping while each jump kills. At most once every 2 days.
When an enemy damages the wearer, 25% chance to cast ice spike at the attacker, an icicle that damages them. At most once every 20 to 30 seconds. Glints of rime over the wearer.

When an enemy hits the wearer in melee, 30% chance to cast fire shield on themselves: for 20 seconds a shield sets melee attackers alight. At most once every 45 to 60 seconds. Thin smoke and embers rise off the wearer, with an orange glow.

Ranged hits on hostile pawns 9 tiles or more away have a 4% to 6% chance (per attack of an average weapon) to cast thunderbolt on the victim, if they stand under open sky. A bolt deals 25 burn damage on the cell, with a 6 tile EMP blast that also hits friendly shield belts, turrets and mechs, and a small fire blast. The damage does not grow with the weapon.

Hits on hostile pawns have a 3% to 5% chance (per attack of an average weapon) to cast snap freeze on the victim. Everyone within 3 tiles, allies and animals included but never the holder, is frozen for about 6 seconds (less above freezing) and chilled toward hypothermia. The same target is not affected again for 30 seconds, and a repeat within that time freezes for half as long.

Ranged hits on hostile pawns 8 tiles or more away have an 8% to 12% chance (per attack of an average weapon) to cast bramble maze on the victim. Brambles cover every fertile cell within 6 tiles that has no building or tree, replacing crops, for 1 hour. They roughly halve walking speed and give no cover. At most once every 30 seconds.
When the wearer is downed, casts stabilize on themselves, stopping bleeding for about 2.4 hours. At most once every 20 to 28 hours.
